name: Fadel Zeidan
abstract_title: Disentangling self from pain: Brain mechanisms supporting the modulation of pain by mindfulness meditation and psychedelics
abstract: Background The relationship between consciousness, pain, and self-referential processing offers a promising framework for understanding how psychedelic and mindfulness-based interventions modulate the subjective experience of pain. Phantom limb pain (PLP) and chronic low back pain (cLBP) are debilitating conditions with limited effective treatments and strong affective-cognitive components.
